_comment: The Google Forms an applicant completes, in order. This is an interim route while the built-in application system waits on a database and SMTP credentials. Keeping the links here rather than hardcoded in the page means Alif can change a form URL without touching code. Verified against the live forms on 24 August 2026 - see `verified` on each.

forms.title: Pre-Employment form
forms.summary: Your name, email, where you live, how long you have worked in care, whether you drive, and your DBS status. This is the one that reaches us — once it is in, we can contact you.
forms.verified: 2026-08-24: opens publicly on a signed-out phone browser, no sign-in. Name confirmed by Alif as 'Pre-Employment form'.

forms.title: Application Form
forms.summary: The rest of your application details.
forms.verified: 2026-09-08: RE-TESTED after Alif said he removed the sign-in requirement. STILL LOCKED - the viewform returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized to a signed-out request, while form 1's viewform returns 200. So the change did not take. Remaining likely causes, in order: (1) 'Collect email addresses' is set to 'Verified' rather than 'Responder input' - Verified requires a Google login; (2) 'Limit to 1 response' is still on (Settings > Responses); (3) the form is restricted to an organisation. Keep requiresGoogleAccount true until a signed-out browser can open it; set it false and the warning disappears from the page. Earlier 2026-08-24 re-test also found it locked.
